veranderings.rede: AWS: a comma separates the verbs of two clauses that meet ('vlieg' and 'het'), which also stops the learner misreading 'vlieg het' as one verb group.

veranderings.na: Aan die agterkant en by die punt
veranderings.rede: A bare 'Agter' opening the sentence is terse and vague; 'aan die agterkant' says plainly that it is the back edge of the wing.
The subject is the colour, and colour does not 'have' spots or stripes; it forms them, which keeps the meaning and the 'kan'.
'n Meganiese een' copies the English 'a mechanical one'; repeating the noun is the natural Afrikaans form (a different change from the restructure rejected earlier).

veranderings.voor: is uit baie aparte vere gebou
veranderings.na: is uit baie aparte vere opgebou
veranderings.rede: 'Opgebou uit' is the idiomatic way to say something is made up of many parts; 'gebou uit' reads as constructing a building.
